title: Anthropic buys biotech startup Coefficient Bio in $400M deal
raw_excerpt: Anthropic acquired biotech AI startup Coefficient Bio for $400 million in stock to bolster its healthcare and life sciences ventures. Coefficient Bio, founded by former Genentech researchers, used AI to expedite drug discovery and biological research. The 10-person team will integrate into Anthropic's health and life sciences division.
summary: Anthropic以4亿美元股票收购生物技术AI初创公司Coefficient Bio，后者由前基因泰克研究员创立，专注于AI加速药物发现。10人团队将并入Anthropic健康与生命科学部门。此举标志着AI巨头向生命科学领域的重要扩张，凸显AI在药物研发中的战略价值。

title: Show HN: I built a tiny LLM to demystify how language models work
raw_excerpt:
Built a ~9M param LLM from scratch to understand how they actually work. Vanilla transformer, 60K synthetic conversations, ~130 lines of PyTorch. Trains in 5 min on a free Colab T4. The fish thinks the meaning of life is food.

Fork it and swap the personality for your own character.
summary: 开发者用约130行PyTorch代码构建了一个仅9M参数的微型LLM（GuppyLM），在免费Colab T4上5分钟即可完成训练。该项目旨在通过极简实现帮助理解Transformer工作原理，包含6万条合成对话数据，并支持自定义角色个性。

title: Interaction-Aware Video Object Removal (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Netflix's VOID is a video inpainting model that removes objects along with their physical and visual interactions, using interaction-aware mask conditioning built on CogVideoX.
summary: Netflix开源视频修复模型VOID，基于CogVideoX实现交互感知的物体移除。与传统修复不同，VOID能同时删除物体及其物理和视觉交互痕迹（如阴影、水花），通过交互感知掩码条件提升真实感，为视频编辑提供更自然的物体去除方案。

title: Running Gemma 4 locally with LM Studio's new headless CLI and Claude Code
summary: LM Studio推出无头CLI模式，支持在本地运行Google Gemma 4模型，并与Claude Code集成。用户可在本地硬件上部署最新开源大模型，无需云端API，兼顾隐私与性能。该方案为开发者提供了低成本、高可控的本地AI推理新选择。

title: Benchmarking Multi-turn Medical Diagnosis: Hold, Lure, and Self-Correction
raw_excerpt:
作者: Jinrui Fang, Runhan Chen, Xu Yang, Jian Yu, Jiawei Xu, Ashwin Vinod, Wenqi Shi, Tianlong Chen, Heng Ji, ChengXiang Zhai, Ying Ding, Yuji Zhang
摘要: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high accuracy in medical diagnosis when all clinical information is provided in a single turn, yet how they behave under multi-turn evidence accumulation closer to real clinical reasoning remains unexplored. We introduce MINT (Medical Incremental N-Turn Benchmark), a high-fidelity, multi-turn medical diagnosis benchmark comprising 1,035 cases with clinically labeled evidence shards, controlled turn granularity, and information-preserving decomposition. Through systematic evaluation of 11 LLMs on MINT, we uncover three persistent behavioral patterns that significantly impact diagnostic decisions: (1) intent to answer, models rush to answer before sufficient evidence has been observed, with over 55% of answers committed within the first two turns; (2) self-correction, incorrect-to-correct answer revisions occur at up to 10.6 times the rate of correct-to-incorrect flips, revealing a latent capacity for self-correction that premature commitment forecloses; and (3) strong lures, clinically salient information such as laboratory results trigger premature answering even when models are explicitly instructed to wait. We translate these findings into clinically actionable guidance: deferring the diagnostic question to later turns reduces premature answering and improves accuracy at the first point o…
summary: 研究团队推出MINT基准测试，包含1035例多轮医学诊断案例，模拟真实临床中证据逐步积累的过程。测试发现LLM在单轮诊断中准确率高，但在多轮对话中表现显著下降，且易受误导信息干扰。该工作揭示了当前模型在动态诊断场景中的关键短板。

title: SKILL0: In-Context Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Skill Internalization
summary: SKILL0提出一种上下文强化学习方法，使LLM智能体能在推理过程中内化技能，无需微调即可通过上下文示例学习新能力。该方法在多个Agent任务上取得显著提升，为构建可快速适应新任务的通用智能体提供了新范式。

title: A Taxonomy of RL Environments for LLM Agents
raw_excerpt: RL environments are training grounds for agents. Task distribution determines what skills agents develop, and harnesses control how they interact. Verifiers define what 'good' means. The state and configuration determine how realistic the training is.
summary: 一篇系统性的博客文章对LLM智能体的强化学习环境进行了分类学梳理，从任务分布、交互控制、验证器、状态配置四个维度分析不同环境的设计选择。该框架有助于研究者理解RL环境如何塑造智能体能力，并为设计更有效的训练环境提供指导。

title: Anthropic Ended Subscription-Based OpenClaw Usage
raw_excerpt: Anthropic announced that Claude Code subscribers can no longer use subscription limits for tools like OpenClaw, shifting to separate pay-as-you-go pricing for third-party integrations.
summary: Anthropic宣布调整Claude Code订阅政策，用户不再能使用订阅额度调用OpenClaw等第三方工具，需改为按量付费。此举旨在分离核心服务与第三方集成成本，可能影响依赖多工具链的开发者工作流，引发社区对平台锁定风险的讨论。

title: Meta Pauses Work With Mercor After Data Breach Puts AI Industry Secrets at Risk
raw_excerpt: Meta paused its work with Mercor following a security breach that may have exposed proprietary AI training data.
summary: Meta因数据泄露事件暂停与AI数据标注公司Mercor的合作。该漏洞可能暴露了专有的AI训练数据，涉及行业机密。事件凸显AI供应链中的数据安全风险，以及大型科技公司在第三方合作中的监管挑战。

title: Show HN: Gemma Gem – AI model embedded in a browser – no API keys, no cloud
raw_excerpt:
Gemma Gem is a Chrome extension that loads Google's Gemma 4 (2B) through WebGPU in an offscreen document and gives it tools to interact with any webpage: read content, take screenshots, click elements, type text, scroll, and run JavaScript.

You get a small chat overlay on every page. Ask it about the page and it (usually) figures out which tools to call. It has a thinking mode that shows chain-of-thought reasoning as it works.

It's a 2B model in a browser. It works for simple page questions and running JavaScript, but multi-step tool chains are unreliable and it sometimes ignores its tools entirely. The agent loop has zero external dependencies and can be extracted as a standalone library if anyone wants to experiment with it.
summary: 开发者发布Chrome扩展Gemma Gem，将Google Gemma 4（2B）模型通过WebGPU完全在浏览器中运行，无需API密钥或云端。扩展可读取页面内容、截图、点击元素、执行JavaScript，实现本地AI助手。尽管多步工具调用尚不稳定，但展示了端侧AI的潜力。
